piezas.titulo: Production practice: Register, audience and own voice
texto: Integrated conversation: teaching an advanced workshop on institutional writing and oratory. At Distinguished level you are assessed on the ability to reformulate in real time a dense formal sentence into accessible everyday language, and vice versa, explaining with erudition and charm which particles, pronouns and collocations must change so as not to sound pedantic or excessively familiar. Use stylistic markers such as «ขึ้นอยู่กับความสัมพันธ์ระหว่างผู้พูดและผู้ฟัง» (it depends on the relationship between speaker and listener) and «ความเหมาะสมทางกาลเทศะ» (appropriateness to the occasion and setting).
